caption: Did you know your body has its own 'clean-up crew'? 🧹 Macrophages are immune cells that 'eat' pathogens, keeping you healthy! 💡 They play a key role in inflammation and immune response. 🌟 Here are some fascinating facts about macrophages: they can engulf foreign particles, present antigens to T-cells, and even help heal wounds. 🤩 Save this so you don't lose it.
